meta.scope: First-year math and the math/statistics courses that CS prerequisites name, from the 2026-27 calendar (13.9 Mathematics and Statistics). Offered terms come from the Department of Mathematics and Statistics' usual-offerings table.
caveats: The department says offerings are not confirmed until the Registrar posts them.
Only BIOL 1001 and ECE 7410 (named by COMP 3550 and COMP 4301) are still not loaded.
meta.program_note: Required for the CS major per calendar 11.4.4: MATH 1000 or 1006, 1001, 2000, 2050, and STAT 2500 or 2550.
